evals.prompt: Estou criando um projeto NestJS do zero com TypeORM e PostgreSQL. Preciso instalar e configurar o nestjs-rest-query pra usar filtros dinâmicos nos meus endpoints. Me ajuda a fazer o setup completo — main.ts, app.module.ts — tudo que precisa pra funcionar.
evals.expected_output: Complete setup with: pnpm/npm install command for nestjs-rest-query, main.ts with extended query parser + ValidationPipe with enableImplicitConversion, app.module.ts with DynamicQueryBuilderModule.forRoot(). All bootstrap steps present and correct. NO references to a private registry or @multitechbr scope.
expectations: Output includes pnpm add nestjs-rest-query OR npm install nestjs-rest-query
Output does NOT include any .npmrc with @multitechbr or private registry configuration
Output includes app.set('query parser', 'extended') in main.ts
Output includes ValidationPipe with transform: true and enableImplicitConversion: true
Output includes DynamicQueryBuilderModule.forRoot() in app.module.ts imports
Output imports from 'nestjs-rest-query' (NOT '@multitechbr/nestjs-dynamic-query-builder')
Output does NOT skip any of the mandatory bootstrap steps
Code examples are syntactically valid TypeScript

evals.prompt: Tenho uma entidade Product com campos: id, name, price, category, createdAt, deletedAt. Preciso criar um endpoint GET /products que suporte filtrar por name (case-insensitive), price (range), category (múltiplos valores), ordenar por name e price, paginar, e excluir soft-deleted automaticamente. Usa o nestjs-rest-query.
evals.expected_output: Controller with @ApiDynamicQuery having filters for name/price/category, sorts for name/price, and a service using queryBuilderService.execute() with customize callback for soft delete (deletedAt IS NULL). Uses ilike for name, between for price range, in for category.
expectations: Controller uses @ApiDynamicQuery decorator with filters array including name, price, category
Controller uses @QueryRules() parameter decorator paired with @Query() DynamicQueryDto
Sorts whitelist includes name and price (not createdAt or deletedAt)
Service uses queryBuilderService.execute() with repository, query, and rules parameters
Customize callback adds andWhere for deletedAt IS NULL (soft delete filtering)
Does NOT expose deletedAt in filters whitelist (security)
Code mentions ilike for case-insensitive name search or documents operator usage
Imports come from 'nestjs-rest-query' (NOT the old @multitechbr scope)

evals.prompt: Tenho entidades Order (id, status, total, createdAt) com ManyToOne para Customer (id, name, email) e OneToMany para OrderItem (id, quantity, unitPrice) que tem ManyToOne para Product (id, name). Preciso de um endpoint GET /orders que permita filtrar por status, customer.name (case-insensitive), incluir customer e items com items.product, e ordenar por createdAt e total. Também preciso de field selection e que a resposta seja paginada.
evals.expected_output: Controller with @ApiDynamicQuery having nested filters (customer.name), includes for customer/items/items.product, fields selection, sorts. Service using execute(). Correct dot-notation for nested filtering with parent relation in includes.
expectations: Filters include 'status' and 'customer.name' with dot notation for nested field
Includes array has 'customer', 'items', 'items.product' for nested relationships
Fields array is defined and includes sort fields (createdAt, total must be in fields)
Sorts array has 'createdAt' and 'total' and both are also present in fields array
Uses @ApiDynamicQuery or @DynamicQuery decorator (not manual query building)
@QueryRules() is used to inject rules into the handler method
Service delegates to queryBuilderService.execute() with all parameters

evals.prompt: Quero usar nestjs-rest-query num projeto que já está rodando com Drizzle ORM e Postgres (não tenho TypeORM). Como faço o setup pra que execute() trabalhe com a minha tabela users (com relação ManyToOne para companies)? Mostra desde forRoot até o serviço.
evals.expected_output: AppModule registers DynamicQueryBuilderModule.forRoot({ adapter: new DrizzleAdapter() }) imported from 'nestjs-rest-query/drizzle'. Service builds a DrizzleSource with db, table, and relations, and passes it to queryBuilderService.execute(source, query, rules). No TypeORM Repository involved.
expectations: forRoot is called with adapter: new DrizzleAdapter()
DrizzleAdapter is imported from 'nestjs-rest-query/drizzle' (subpath export)
Service constructs a DrizzleSource object with db, table, and relations keys
relations declares 'company' with type: 'one' and an on: { localKey, foreignKey } shape
queryBuilderService.execute() receives the DrizzleSource (not a TypeORM Repository)
Output does NOT import @nestjs/typeorm or use InjectRepository
Bootstrap (main.ts) still includes query parser 'extended' and ValidationPipe with enableImplicitConversion
